title: Earned Trust, Recursive Handshake & Plan-Gated Autonomy
objective: Implement Titan Zero autonomy as progressively earned responsibility. The entire workforce is available reactively on Free; successful trust cycles make higher hierarchy behaviours system-ready but not active. Activation requires plan entitlement, explicit user unlock/delegation and recursive acceptance by the relevant execution chain. Each hierarchy class has an increasing maximum autonomy ceiling, concentrating the greatest autonomy in the fewest agents.

subgoals.completion_basis: acceptance gates and complete outcome, not planned pass count
